name: Example: Switches and a breaker
description: Each circuit is 10 V into a 10 Ω load, 1 A when closed. The pulsed switch follows a 5 Hz Boolean pulse on its control input. The closing switch closes at 0.1 s and the opening switch opens then. The two-way switch moves the current from a 10 Ω load (1 A) to a 20 Ω load (0.5 A). The breaker opens a 10 Ω, 10 mH circuit at 0.1 s: its arc voltage rises from 30 V until it forces the current to zero.
